skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the role, nature, and functions of social security, and the content of programs within the social security system such as social insurance, healthcare, social assistance, poverty reduction programs, and commercial insurance.
Apply knowledge of social security and policy content within the social security system to evaluate and improve the management of social security activities.
Develop research and independent work skills, including logical and critical thinking, teamwork, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
Demonstrate self-reliance in independent work and responsibility towards group work.
Understand the necessity and principles of public administration in social security, and the role of the state, economic and social organizations, and individuals in ensuring social security.
Develop critical thinking and analytical skills to evaluate social security policies and programs.
Improve communication skills through group discussions and presentations.
Apply problem-solving skills to real-world social security issues.
Work effectively in teams to complete group assignments and projects.
Enhance presentation skills through group presentations and discussions.
